title: Eight Winters and One Short Gate
subtitle: 公共设施 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 公共设施（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通）
meta: 主题语境：公共设施（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通）　|　核心词汇：facility　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 facility 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 my uncle ① opened a facility that no officer in the town would have used, and he said the opening was the whole of the winter. The ② facility, meaning the building itself and not the service, ran eight winters and stayed unused in the book; a facility, he said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how long it is left unused.

Every ③ facility in that town had the same short gate beside it, and the ④ facility at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A facility, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to use; my uncle said the using is the part that fills eight winters.

My aunt meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the facility was the whole of the plan, meaning the equipment and not the building. The ⑥ facility, meaning the equipment and not any of that, is the only thing in a plan that everybody waits for and nobody uses; facility, she said, is either something you open or the only word that means both a building and equipment. She said the equipment is the part they remember.

By 1982 the ⑦ facility had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short gate. The ⑧ facility of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in January, was one town and eight winters of using; facility, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to use. He said the using was never mentioned.

The ⑨ facility I remember is the one used in the list, which closed in 1985 and is still described as the quietest in the town. A ⑩ facility, my mother said in 1987, is the only one that improves by being used; every facility, she said, is equipment that has agreed to look like a building. She said the equipment was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 设施；场馆（指镇上每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 设施（指那座建筑本身，与服务相对）
C. 固定搭配：open a facility 启用一处设施
D. n. 设施（指留给孩子的那一处）
E. n. 设施（抽象总称，指一座镇子上的设施之事）
F. n. 设施（指清单上写到、被使用的那一处）
G. n. 设备；装备（指一份方案里人人都等却无人使用的那样东西）
H. n. 设备（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人使用的那样东西）

items.q: opened a facility that no officer in the town would have used
The facility, meaning the building itself and not the service
the facility at the far side
the facility was the whole of the plan
the facility had become a line in a list
The facility of the whole thing
A facility, my mother said in 1987

answers.why: open a facility 意为“启用一处设施”，1975 年叔叔启用了一处镇上没有一位官员肯使用的设施。
facility 意为“设施”，指那座建筑本身而不是服务，它经过了八个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
facility 意为“设施”，指镇上每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一道短短的大门。
facility 意为“设施”，指留给孩子的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
facility 意为“设备、装备”，指一份方案里人人都等却无人使用的那样东西，姑姑说这批设备就是那份方案的全部。
facility 意为“设备”，指人人都等却无人使用的那样东西而不是那座建筑，是方案里人人都等、却无人使用的东西。
facility 意为“设施”，指清单上写到、被使用的那一处，到 1982 年这一处成了清单里的一行。
facility 意为“设施”，叔叔一月写道，整件事的设施之事是一座镇子和八个冬天的使用。
facility 意为“设施”，我记得的是清单上使用的那一处，1985 年结束了，至今仍被说成镇上最安静的一处。
facility 为抽象总称，母亲 1987 年说，一处设施是唯一会因为被好好使用而变得更好的东西。
